svg.aria-label: Negative-space carve study of a sphere. A dense uniform field of fine horizontal rules at 4px pitch fills the plate; the sphere is present only as the carved void the rules refuse to enter, with a hard flat edge at the disc. On the shadow side of the rim a thin crescent of concentric arc-rules is compressed and deflected to hug the carved edge, tightening as the limb darkens. Tone is line density alone: no fills, no gradients.
svg.text: HORIZONTAL RULE FIELD AS ABSENCE / 253 FIELD RULES @ 4.00PX (138 ROWS) / CRESCENT: 59 DEFLECTED ARC-RULES, SHADOW LIMB @ 51° ±88° SPAN, RADIAL PITCH 3.60→1.15PX (COMPRESSED), BAND ≤34PX / HARD CARVE AT R=230 / LAMBERT n·L, L=(−0.6,−0.75,0.5)
